name: Kodoku na Neko Shoujo o Hirotte Hajimaru, Iyashi no Kozukuri Seikatsu
original_name: 孤独な猫少女を拾って始まる、癒しの子作り生活
source:
One day, the protagonist finds a cat girl on the street, and decides to adopt her.
It seems she was driven out of her youkai home in the forest, and got lost in the human town.
The protagonist decides to have her live with him, and she pays him back with sex.
Such was the start of their lovey life.
[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE304661.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
有一天，主角在街上发现了一只猫女孩，并决定收养她。
看来她是被赶出了森林里妖怪的家，在人类城镇里迷路了。
主角决定让她和他住在一起，她用性来回报他。
他们的爱情生活就这样开始了。
[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE304661.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
